## Shared packages

| Package | Latest | This repo |
|---|---|---|
| `@taedron/ui` | v0.18.0 | — (not a consumer) |
| `@taedron/access` | v0.2.0 | **this is the package** (v0.2.0) |

Adoption is **deliberate and per-app** (suite decision S-004) — a new tag propagates to
nobody. To adopt one:

```bash
rm -rf node_modules/@taedron/ui && npm install "github:Taedron/taedron-ui#vX.Y.Z"
```

npm caches `github:` tags, so a plain `npm install` silently reuses the old version.
